prompt.problemSummary: Runtime incidents were observed but no remediation work orders were generated because the telemetry-to-system mapping step failed.
symptoms: alerts continued without assigned work orders
rootCauseHypotheses: telemetry parser emitted component aliases not present in the graph

completion.validatedRootCause: Telemetry component aliases were not normalized before graph lookup, causing impacted systems to resolve to an empty set.
completion.solutionSummary: Normalize system and component identifiers before graph lookup and fail closed into a bounded change request with explicit unknown mappings.
reusablePatterns: normalize external identifiers before graph traversal
emit fallback change requests when graph mapping is incomplete
preventionRules: require graph lookup tests for every telemetry adapter
treat empty impact resolution as a diagnosable incident
